contract: Four rows: left 4x, left self 4, right 4x, right self 4; the other hand throws 2x in every row.
crossSet selects the 2x in rows one and three; selfSet selects it in rows two and four. Each accepts normal, shuffle, reverse, inverted.
All sixteen combinations have three balls, four movement sets and four identity sets.
Each call returns an independent document. Invalid styles are rejected. Both normal styles preserve the existing Double Box.
The Double selection hides column layout and left/right style fields while preserving their values for switching back.
Create and append use the existing document, connection suggestion, validation and saved-draft paths. Selecting parts alone does not edit the draft.
Optional crossReleaseGrip and selfReleaseGrip independently override only the corresponding 2x release. Omission preserves the previous automatic grip.
Each grip accepts underhand or overhand; invalid values including null are rejected. Release-only overrides preserve ball tracks, hand-center tracks and catch grips.
UI grip choices are Standard, support from below, and claw; hidden choices persist when returning from another role.
The sixteen generic cases use default grips. Two source mappings and their connection additionally verify explicit underhand shuffle with the real rig.
Optional crossCatchGrip and selfCatchGrip independently override the receiving hand of the corresponding 2x flight. Omission preserves the automatic catch grip.
Catch overrides preserve explicit release settings, all 4-side grips, ball tracks and hand-center tracks. Four catch combinations are tested on a Double with two rising transfers.
The preview lists release and catch choices separately for 4x and self-4 phases. Standard is distinct from an explicit underhand or overhand choice.
